label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle073Subtitle
text: *So many troops, General. You weren't actually planning to rush me with them were you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle074Subtitle
text: *That's quite a base you have going there, General. You did remember to space out your buildings to avoid weapon strikes, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle075Subtitle
text: *Do you know how long it's going to take to clean that up?!?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle076Subtitle
text: *Get that disgusting radiation out of my base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle077Subtitle
text: *Hey, that's my Particle Cannon! You're not authorized to use it!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle078Subtitle
text: *Is that a tactical move, or are you just hiding?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle079Subtitle
text: *Colonel Burton? Really? Do you think he's going to help you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle080Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus? I guess it's just a girl-power showdown, isn't it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle081Subtitle
text: *Jarmen Kell! He better stay away from my tanks!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle082Subtitle
text: *Nice Air Field, General--just keep those planes away from my Particle Cannon

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle083Subtitle
text: *A War Factory? You're seriously going to attack me, aren't you? It's about time

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle084Subtitle
text: *Good for you - you can build a barracks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle085Subtitle
text: *Selling your buildings? Is that part of your going out of business sale?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle086Subtitle
text: *Why don't you just give up? I have better things I could be doing today

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle087Subtitle
text: *Why can't I ever find one that lasts more than 5 minutes

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle088Subtitle
text: *Looks like you're losing, General. Now what did I say about planning to fail?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle089Subtitle
text: *That's quite a beating you're taking, General. Are you ready for more?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle090Subtitle
text: *I'd like to say, "good fight," but clearly your mind wasn't in it, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle091Subtitle
text: *I can't believe you would beat-up on a girl like this

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle092Subtitle
text: *I need time to think. Go away, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle093Subtitle
text: *Your tactics are hardly sporting, General. Play nice!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle094Subtitle
text: *General, look over there! Someone is capturing your buildings! Didn't buy it, huh?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle095Subtitle
text: *You know, if you were a gentleman, you'd give me five minutes to rebuild my defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle096Subtitle
text: *What?! It's over? Well, it was nice dancing with you, General. Maybe next time I'll lead

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle097Subtitle
text: *My Super Weapons are ready... are you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle098Subtitle
text: *You'll never crack my defenses, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle099Subtitle
text: *Your rush tactics won't work on me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle100Subtitle
text: *It's not fair! One more Super Weapon and I would have beaten you, General. Challenge me again, I dare you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle101Subtitle
text: *I told you you'd never beat my Super Weapons, General. Care to try again?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle102Subtitle
text: *Welcome, General. Are you ready to begin?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle103Subtitle
text: *Oh, what's that sound? Now I see a light in the sky... Hmm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle104Subtitle
text: *Oh my!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle106Subtitle
text: *oh dearI'm sorry, General, but that's just how I like to say, "hello." Well, good luck, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Turtle107Subtitle
text: *Well, good luck, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina001Subtitle
text: *The Americans use the Sentry Drone as an early warning enemy detection system. The drone becomes invisible when it is not moving, and we've seen some of them upgraded with machine guns. Though no match for tanks, the drone can cause problems for foot soldiers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina002Subtitle
text: *The American Microwave Tank is a big microwave gun that disables structures and vehicles. The radiation from the tank can also hurt infantry, so keep our men at a safe distance

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina003Subtitle
text: *The Avenger is an American laser based anti-air vehicle able to shoot down missiles and aircraft. It also helps other US units target our planes, so they should be considered high priority targets when encountered within a battle group

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina004Subtitle
text: *The Specter Gunship is a large jet powered aircraft with multiple weapon systems fixed to its side enabling it to circle a target area and rain death from above. Typical American engineering--using a shotgun to swat a fly

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina005Subtitle
text: *The Chemical Suit upgrade, makes infantry more resistant to toxins and radiation

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina006Subtitle
text: *The US Countermeasures upgrade reduces the effectiveness of enemy fire against their air units. Missiles will often miss, and bullets do less damage

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina007Subtitle
text: *The US Hellfire Drone upgrade creates an remote air drone that defends the parent vehicle with an automated hellfire missile system

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina008Subtitle
text: *The Bunker Buster is an upgrade to the US Stealth Fighter and the Aurora designed to penetrate garrisoned buildings

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina009Subtitle
text: *The Supply Lines Upgrade increases the rate that the US gathers resources from supply docks, supply drops, and oil derricks

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina010Subtitle
text: *The US Generals have seen the wisdom of propaganda. By using a Leaflet Drop they are able to temporarily disable units while they stop to read the propaganda

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina011Subtitle
text: *The MOAB is an upgrade to the US Fuel Air Bomb that includes a stun ability, temporarily shutting down surviving units and structures

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina012Subtitle
text: *The US Fire Base structure is a defensive position surrounded by sandbags and includes a howitzer and 4 firing positions

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina013Subtitle
text: *The Napalm Bomb is an upgrade to our Helix airship, allowing it to drop a pair of bombs which create a large firestorm effect

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina014Subtitle
text: *Our Listening Outpost is a slow, stealthed vehicle with a large sight radius, that can be garrisoned with 2 infantry as guards. Besides uncovering stealthed objects, it can be used to determine enemy destinations by clicking on units in range

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina015Subtitle
text: *Our Helix 2 airship is a slow transport helicopter that can carry infantry or a single vehicle. Although armed with a light machine gun, it can be upgraded with the Gattling Cannon, Propaganda Tower, or Battle Bunker. It can also be upgraded to carry a large napalm bomb

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina016Subtitle
text: *The ECM Tank disrupts electronic tracking systems, diverting enemy missile fire. It's electro-magnetic pulse can be used to disable a single enemy vehicle. It also creates a radar jamming field that disables all drones within its range

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina017Subtitle
text: *The Neutron Shell is an upgrade to our Nuclear Cannon, allowing it to fire neutron shells. These shells kill all infantry, and vehicle pilots inside the blast radius

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina018Subtitle
text: *The Systems Hack allows your hackers to steal a random Generals power from our enemies. Level 1 allows theft of a 1-star or 3-star power, while level 2 allows theft of a 5-star power

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina019Subtitle
text: *Our new Carpet Bomber plane drops a series of bombs along a targeted path, decimating all enemy forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina020Subtitle
text: *Our Neutron Mines are an alternative to standard explosive mines. Neutron Mines instantly disable vehicles and kill any nearby infantry

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina021Subtitle
text: *Our hackers, once vulnerable to attack, will find safety and increased hacking ability in our new Internet Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina022Subtitle
text: *The Satellite Hack I is an internet Center upgrade that allows a reveal around every opponent's Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina023Subtitle
text: *The Satellite Hack II is an Internet Center upgrade that grants a temporarily reveals the entire map, including stealthed enemy forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina024Subtitle
text: *The GLA Saboteur is a stealth infantry unit that can climb cliffs and effect enemy buildings by entering them. Entering a power plant will temporarily cut power, while entering a superweapon will reset the timer. A saboteur who enters an enemy command center will reset the timers on all enemy General's Powers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina025Subtitle
text: *The Combat Cycle initially comes with a GLA Rebel driver and a mounted machine gun. The Rebel can be replaced with any other GLA infantry, granting the cycle their unique powers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina026Subtitle
text: *The GLA Battle Bus can hold up to 8 infantry, who fire out windows. If destroyed, the heavy steel cabin remains like a bunker

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina027Subtitle
text: *The GLA have upgraded their Workers with Shoes to squeeze even more forced labor from their peasants

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina028Subtitle
text: *The Camo Netting is an upgrade to GLA base defense structures, making them invisible to normal detection

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina029Subtitle
text: *The GLA have begun garrisoning Elite Guard troops equipped with RPGs in all their structures. Use caution when infiltrating any GLA bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina030Subtitle
text: *The GLA Booby Trap upgrade enables the rebel to wire structures and civilian vehicles to explode when the enemy attempts to capture or garrison them. Watch for Rebels lurking around buildings in your area

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina031Subtitle
text: *The GLA tricks have reached a new level. They are now building Fake Structures that look like their real buildings, but are only booby-trapped facades. Destroy everything from range to avoid any GLA surprises

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina032Subtitle
text: *The GPS Scrambler targets an area of units and makes them invisible to normal detection

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina033Subtitle
text: *The Sneak Attack power allows GLA Generals to place a defenseless tunnel network anywhere they have explored. Although slightly weaker than a normal tunnel, it is connected to the main network

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina034Subtitle
text: *The Artillery Platform is a fixed-position cannon capable of single-handedly controlling an area from enemy assault. It should be a priority capture on any battlefield

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina035Subtitle
text: *A Reinforcement Pad allows a free periodic armor airdrop. Free Battlemasters can turn the tide of any battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXChina036Subtitle
text: *The Repair Bay tech building, when captured, allows battlefield repairs for any ground vehicles. Repairs for damaged armor in a forward position can make the difference between victory and defeat

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA001Subtitle
text: *Be careful of the American Sentry Drone, General; it can see stealthed units and often has a mounted gun

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA002Subtitle
text: *The US Microwave Tank has a beam that disables structures and units. It should be attacked by large groups only

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA003Subtitle
text: *The US Warlock Tank has a beam that disables structures and units. It should be attacked by large groups only

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA004Subtitle
text: *The US Avenger is a powerful laser-base anti-air vehiclebut we have no planes, so the danger from it is minimal

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA005Subtitle
text: *The American Specter Gunship is a large plane with big guns. Do not engage it--seek refuge underground until it leaves the area

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA006Subtitle
text: *With the Chemical Suit upgrade, enemy infantry become more resistant to our toxins. But that won't stop our bullets, will it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA007Subtitle
text: *The Countermeasures upgrade reduces the effect of enemy fire against US air units. Missiles will often miss, and bullets do less damage

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA008Subtitle
text: *The US Hellfire Drone upgrade is a little toy plane with a missile attached. Another example of American's cowardly tactics

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA009Subtitle
text: *The Bunker Buster Bomb is an upgrade to the US Stealth Fighter and the Aurora. They use it to try to attack our bunkers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA010Subtitle
text: *The Supply Lines Upgrade increases the rate that the US gathers resources from supply docks, supply drops, and oil derricks

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA011Subtitle
text: *The US Leaflet Drop temporarily disables our units as they stop to read the propaganda

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA012Subtitle
text: *The MOAB is an upgrade to the Fuel Air Bomb that includes a stun ability, temporarily shutting down surviving units and structures

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA013Subtitle
text: *The Fire Base is the American answer to our Stinger sites...but watch out for the big cannon in the middle

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA014Subtitle
text: *China's Napalm Bomb is a Helix upgrade, allowing it to drop a pair of bombs which create a large firestorm

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA015Subtitle
text: *The Listening Outpost is a slow, stealthed vehicle the China uses to find our stealthed units. Avoid them to remain hidden

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA016Subtitle
text: *China's Helix 2 is a slow transport helicopter that can carry infantry or a single vehicle

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA017Subtitle
text: *The Chinese ECM Tank is a vehicle which disrupts electronic tracking systems, diverting enemy missile fire

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA018Subtitle
text: *The Neutron Shell is an upgrade to the Chinese Nuke Cannon, allowing it to fire neutron shells. These shells kill all infantry, and vehicle pilots inside the blast radius

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA019Subtitle
text: *China's new Systems Hack technique allows hackers to steal a random power from their enemies. Such is the downfall of depending on power to fight wars

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA020Subtitle
text: *The Carpet Bomber is a plane that drops a series of bombs along a targeted path, decimating the enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA021Subtitle
text: *The Neutron Mines are an alternative to standard Chinese Mines which disable vehicles. The mines still kill infantry as well

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA022Subtitle
text: *The Internet Center allows China's hackers to increase their effectiveness

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA023Subtitle
text: *The Satellite Hack I is an internet Center upgrade that allows China to see every opponent's Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA024Subtitle
text: *The Satellite Hack II is a Chinese Internet Center upgrade that grants a temporary reveal of the entire map, as well as revealing stealthed objects

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA025Subtitle
text: *The Saboteur is a stealth unit that can climb cliffs and effect enemy buildings by entering them

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA026Subtitle
text: *Our new Combat Cycle has mounted machine guns and is enhanced by the abilities of any infantry riding it

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA027Subtitle
text: *The Battle Bus is a slow moving transport that can hold up to 8 infantry, who may fire out of the bus. If destroyed, the hull of the Battle Bus remains and functions like a bunker

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA028Subtitle
text: *The Worker Shoes upgrade increase speed and gathering efficiency for all our loyal workers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA029Subtitle
text: *The Camo Netting is an upgrade to our base defense structures, allowing them to be stealthed

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA030Subtitle
text: *The Elite Guard Upgrade is a structure ability, garrisoning the structure with 4 RPG Troopers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA031Subtitle
text: *The Booby Trap is an upgrade to the rebel, allowing the unit to wire structures and civilian vehicles to explode when the enemy attempts to capture or garrison them. Captured structures are automatically booby trapped

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA032Subtitle
text: *Fake Structures can be built for a greatly reduced cost. These buildings are initially a booby-trapped façade, but can be upgraded to fully functional versions of the structure

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA033Subtitle
text: *Our newly acquired GPS Scrambler targets an area of units and renders them invisible to enemies

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA034Subtitle
text: *Our Sneak Attack allows placement of a defenseless tunnel network at any area that has been explored. Although slightly weaker than a normal tunnel, it is connected to the main network

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA035Subtitle
text: *The Artillery Platform fires a weapon similar to the US Strategy Center in terms of range and damage. Capture or avoid its deadly cannon

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA036Subtitle
text: *The Reinforcement Pad periodically delivers a group of Scorpion tanks for our cause

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXGLA037Subtitle
text: *The Repair Bay is a front-line repair facility for vehicles. It repairs vehicles like an Arms Dealer

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA001Subtitle
text: *The Sentry Drone is a mobile unit capable of tracking enemy movements, including those that are camouflaged. The Sentry Drone itself is also capable of stealth when not moving, and may be upgraded with an anti-personnel machine gun from the strategy center

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA002Subtitle
text: *The Microwave Tank is armed with a Direct-Energy microwave panel that disables targeted structures and vehicles. It also emits a continuous microwave field which damages infantry

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA003Subtitle
text: *The Warlock tank is armed with a Direct-Energy microwave panel that disables targeted structures and vehicles. It also emits a continuous microwave field which damages infantry

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA004Subtitle
text: *The Avenger is a laser based anti-air vehicle able to shoot down missiles and aircraft. It can also award bonuses to units attacking it's "painted" target

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA005Subtitle
text: *The Specter Gunship is a large jet powered aircraft with multiple weapon systems fixed to it's wings. While it circles the target, it auto-acquires enemies. Manual targeting is allowed, and it can upgrade to deploy countermeasures

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA006Subtitle
text: *With the Chemical Suit upgrade, infantry become more resistant to toxins and radiation

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA007Subtitle
text: *The Countermeasures upgrade reduces the effect of enemy fire against US air units. Missiles will often miss, and bullets do less damage

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA008Subtitle
text: *The Hellfire Drone upgrade equips the parent vehicle with a drone capable of firing a single missile. The drones auto-acquire and require time to reload

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA009Subtitle
text: *The Bunker Buster is an upgrade to the Stealth Fighter and the Aurora. In addition to their normal effects, these upgraded missiles damage and even kill units garrisoned within structures, including the GLA Palace, Tunnel Network, and the Chinese Battle Bunker

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA010Subtitle
text: *The Supply Lines Upgrade increases the amount of money gathered from supply docks, supply drops, and oil derricks

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA011Subtitle
text: *The Leaflet Drop temporarily disables units as they stop to read the propaganda. The plane dispenses leaflets over the targeted area and the effect only lasts a short time

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA012Subtitle
text: *The MOAB is an upgrade to the Fuel Air Bomb that includes a stun ability, temporarily shutting down surviving units and structures

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA013Subtitle
text: *The Fire Base is surrounded by sandbags and includes a howitzer and 4 firing positions. Infantry entering the Fire Base will take firing positions behind the sandbags

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA014Subtitle
text: *The Napalm Bomb is a Helix upgrade, allowing it to drop a pair of bombs which create a large firestorm

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA015Subtitle
text: *The Listening Outpost is a slow, stealthed vehicle with a large sight radius, and can be garrisoned with 2 infantry as guards. Besides uncovering stealthed objects, it can be used to determine enemy destinations by clicking on units in range

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA016Subtitle
text: *The Helix 2 is a slow transport helicopter that can carry infantry or a single vehicle. Although armed with a light machine gun, it can be upgraded with the Gattling Cannon, Propaganda Tower, or Battle Bunker. It can also be upgraded to carry a large napalm bomb

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA017Subtitle
text: *The ECM Tank is a vehicle which disrupts electronic tracking systems, diverting enemy missile fire. It's ECM pulse can be used to disable single enemy vehicles. Finally, it creates a radar jamming field, disabling all drones within its range

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA018Subtitle
text: *The Neutron Shell is an upgrade to the Chinese Nuke Cannon, allowing it to fire neutron shells. These shells kill all infantry, and vehicle pilots inside the blast radius

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA019Subtitle
text: *The Systems Hack allows your hackers to steal a random power from your enemies. Level 1 allows theft of a tier 1 or 3 power, while level 2 allows theft of a 5-star power

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA020Subtitle
text: *The Carpet Bomber is a plane that drops a series of bombs along a targeted path, decimating the enemy

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA021Subtitle
text: *The Neutron Mines are an alternative to standard Chinese Mines which disable vehicles. The mines still kill infantry as well

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA022Subtitle
text: *The Internet Center allows hackers to increase their effectiveness at generating money, and allows the use of Satellite Hacks I & II

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA023Subtitle
text: *The Satellite Hack I is an internet Center upgrade that allows a reveal around every opponent's Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA024Subtitle
text: *The Satellite Hack II is an internet Center upgrade that grants a temporary reveal of the entire map, as well as revealing stealthed objects

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA025Subtitle
text: *The Saboteur is a stealth unit that can climb cliffs and effect enemy buildings by entering them. Entering a power plant will temporarily cut power, while entering a superweapon will reset the timer. A saboteur who enters an enemy command center will reset the timers on all enemy General's Powers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA026Subtitle
text: *The Combat Cycle initially comes with a Rebel driver and a mounted machine gun. Replacing him with a RPG Trooper will allow the bike to fire missiles. A Terrorist will create a suicide bike. Jarmen Kell, Hijackers, and Saboteurs can also ride, making the bike stealthed

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA027Subtitle
text: *The Battle Van is a slow moving transport that can hold up to 8 infantry, who may fire out of the bus. If destroyed, the hull of the Battle Van remains and functions like a bunker. If it is destroyed, anyone inside is also killed

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA028Subtitle
text: *The Worker Shoes upgrade increase speed and gathering efficiency for all GLA workers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA029Subtitle
text: *The Camo Netting is an upgrade to GLA base defense structures, allowing them to be stealthed

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA030Subtitle
text: *The Elite Guard Upgrade is an structure ability, garrisoning the structure with 4 RPG Troopers

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA031Subtitle
text: *The Booby Trap is an upgrade to the rebel, allowing the unit to wire structures and civilian vehicles to explode when the enemy attempts to capture or garrison them. The explosion damages everything within a small radius. Structures captured by an upgraded rebel are automatically booby trapped

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA032Subtitle
text: *Fake Structures can be built for a greatly reduced cost. These buildings are initially a booby-trapped façade, but can be upgraded to fully functional versions of the structure

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA033Subtitle
text: *The GPS Scrambler targets an area of units and renders them stealthed to enemies

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA034Subtitle
text: *The Sneak Attack allows placement of a defenseless tunnel network at any area that has been explored. Although slightly weaker than a normal tunnel, it is connected to the main network

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA035Subtitle
text: *The artillery platform is armed with a large caliber howitzer. It is an excellent suppression weapon. It is also a good gathering point from which to launch an assault

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA036Subtitle
text: *The Reinforcement Pad Periodically reinforces the player with one of his side's main battle tank (Scorpion, Battlemaster, Crusader)

label: DIALOGEVENT:UnitDescriptXUSA037Subtitle
text: *The Repair Bay is a repair facility for vehicles. Vehicles must dock with the structure in the same way that they must dock with the war factory
